findings.body: When `forge close` has saved `waiting for checks` and CI later turns green, `forge next` treats the PR as ready at `nextstep.py:357-363`. The new agent-merge rule only handles `status == "ready"`, so an unsigned client repo with a PR URL still gets `Next: merge <url>, then forge next`. That directs a human merge instead of completing `forge close` and using `forge merge`.

findings.body: This test calls `forge close` until it has written a ready receipt before checking `forge next`. It never exercises a green PR whose saved state is still `waiting for checks`, so it passes while the command tells an unsigned client to merge manually. Add a real `forge next` check for that state.
